subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation, the `announce:` run-id reservation, and always-tool-free subagent completion announce turns as canonical recovery behavior?
rationale: The patch is coherent and tested, but it changes persisted session lifecycle semantics and a security-relevant internal tool boundary that are maintainer-owned compatibility choices.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, reserved announce run-id prefix, and tool-free announce invariant as the fix for this cascade.

options.title: Harden state first
options.body: Before merge, change the announce marker or reconciliation status if maintainers do not want recovery to depend on the public idempotency-key prefix or killed state.

options.title: Pause for broader model
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want announce, locked-session, and delivery recovery handled through a wider session-delivery redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, reserved announce run-id prefix, and tool-free announce invariant as the fix for this cascade.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh Lehman has recent overlapping history in restart lifecycle seams, gateway lifecycle state, and Codex internal-turn behavior.
